LightningComponentBundle.description: Accepts any valid SQL query configuration id and chart.js configuration json and shows data from Data Cloud and renders chart using chart.js

property.name: chartSubtitle
property.placeholder: Chart subtitle, will appear bellow the title
property.label: Chart Subtitle

property.name: width
property.label: Container Width
property.description: Container Width in view port ratio

property.name: height
property.label: Container Height
property.description: Container Height in view port ratio

property.name: querySettingId
property.label: Query Setting Identifier
property.description: Custom metadata DataCloudQuerySetting__mdt developer name, this is used to fetch the corresponding sql query

property.name: chartConfig
property.label: Chart.js Config (JSON)
property.description: A JSON configuration for Chart.js. 'dataMap' is a special key to map query fields to chart labels and data.
